jobs.description: Introduction Welcome to Gallagher - a global community of people who bring bold ideas, deep expertise, and a shared commitment to doing what’s right. We help clients navigate complexity with confidence by empowering businesses, communities, and individuals to thrive. At Gallagher, you’ll find more than a job; you’ll find a culture built on trust, driven by collaboration, and sustained by the belief that we’re better together. Whether you join us in a client-facing role or as part of our brokerage division, our benefits and HR consulting division, or our corporate team, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, make an impact, and be part of something bigger. Experience a workplace where you’re encouraged to be yourself, supported to succeed, and inspired to keep learning. That’s what it means to live The Gallagher Way. Overview The Strategy & Operations Consultant is part of Gallagher’s Internal Consulting team and helps solve some of the company’s most important business process challenges. In this role, you will work with senior leaders and operational teams to analyze problems, develop solutions, and support improvements from planning through implementation. This is a great opportunity for a strong problem solver who enjoys working across teams, using data to drive decisions, and turning ideas into practical action. How you'll make an impact Analyze data and identify process improvement opportunities Build business cases, requirements, and performance metrics Document current-state and future-state processes Support market entry, profitability, and growth strategy studies Develop action plans and implementation support materials Create reports, training materials, and project updates Present recommendations and help drive performance improvement initiatives About you Bachelor’s degree required English B2+ 2–3 years of management consulting experience Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving skills Ability to analyze both quantitative and qualitative data and turn insights into clear recommendations Advanced proficiency in PowerPoint, Excel, and Word Ability to work independently with limited guidance Strong written and verbal communication skills, including confidence working with senior leaders Sound business judgment and the ability to balance financial and non-financial considerations Experience in the insurance brokerage industry is preferred A collaborative mindset and commitment to continuous learning and professional growth

Submit and manage requests through Workfront and collaborate with internal creative and marketing teams to support project execution. Assist with the activation and implementation of M&A-related marketing campaigns when required. Support due diligence activities by gathering, organizing, and tracking marketing-related information. Experience managing multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment. Proficiency with project management platforms such as Workfront, Smartsheet, or similar tools. Strong technical skills, including advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office applications. Experience supporting mergers and acquisitions (M&A), integration programs, or organizational change initiatives preferred. Ability to work independently while effectively collaborating with cross-functional teams.

jobs.description: Introduction Welcome to Gallagher - a global community of people who bring bold ideas, deep expertise, and a shared commitment to doing what’s right. Experience a workplace where you’re encouraged to be yourself, supported to succeed, and inspired to keep learning. That’s what it means to live The Gallagher Way. How you'll make an impact As the Senior Analyst of Transactional Accounting Process Integration at Arthur J. Gallagher, one of the largest insurance brokerage companies globally, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the seamless transition of transactional accounting functions. This includes banking, cash application, special handling, payables (premium, broker. SLT), premium billing, and direct bill commission processing. The position demands a unique combination of transactional accounting expertise, insurance industry knowledge, and project management skills to drive successful integration processes. This role is instrumental in enabling operational excellence and supporting sustainable growth by ensuring the effective integration of transactional accounting functions across the organization. Key Responsibilities: Integration Planning and Strategy: Develop comprehensive integration plans for transactional accounting functions that align with the company’s strategic objectives and operational requirements. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define integration milestones, timelines, and resource needs. Financial Impact Assessment: Conduct detailed financial analyses to evaluate the impact of integration activities on banking, cash application, special handling, premium billing, and commission billing processes. Partner with NAC teams (Accounts Receivable, Billing, Accounts Payable, Senior Leadership Team) to ensure a smooth transition with proper controls in place. Special Handling: Manage the integration of special handling processes for cash applications, direct bill commission posting, premium, broker commission, & SLT payables. Ensure compliance with Corporate Finance Policy and industry standards while implementing robust controls and reporting mechanisms to mitigate fraud risks. Cash Application and Reconciliation: Lead the integration of cash application processes, documenting special handling procedures and ensuring the Accounts Receivable team is well-prepared. Develop automated cash reconciliation procedures to enhance efficiency and accuracy, reducing manual intervention and minimizing discrepancies. Payables Management for Premiums, Commissions, and Claims: Streamline payables management processes for premium payments, commissions, and claims settlements. Optimize carrier relationships and payment terms while developing standardized workflows and approval processes to improve transparency and control. Premium Billing and Direct Bill Commission Billing: Oversee the integration of premium billing and direct bill commission billing processes, ensuring accuracy and timeliness in invoicing and commission payments. Collaborate with insurance carriers and brokers to reconcile premium accounts and commission statements, resolve discrepancies, and ensure compliance with contractual agreements. Stakeholder Engagement and Communication: Act as a key liaison between accounting teams, business units, insurance carriers, brokers, and external partners throughout the integration process. Communicate integration objectives, progress updates, and potential risks to stakeholders, fostering collaboration and alignment. Change Management and Training: Develop change management strategies to prepare NAC teams for the transition. Provide training and support to transactional teams and operational staff on new processes, systems, and controls introduced during the integration. About You Required: Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting or Finance and 7 years of accounting project experience. 10% - 35% travel required. Proficient in Microsoft Excel and Word. Requires specialized depth and/or breadth of expertise. Preferred: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field; CPA or equivalent certification preferred. Minimum of 7 years of experience in transactional accounting roles within the insurance brokerage or financial services industry, with a focus on premium & broker payables and commission processing. Comprehensive knowledge of insurance accounting principles, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices. Proven track record of leading successful integration projects, with strong project management and change management expertise. Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities, with the capacity to engage and influence stakeholders across all organizational levels. Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team environment. Strong organizational and time management skills to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines effectively. Willingness to travel as needed to acquisition partners and corporate headquarters. Proficiency in accounting software and Microsoft Office applications. #APIntegration #LI-TL1 Compensation and benefits At Gallagher, we believe supporting our colleagues goes far beyond the role itself. jobs.title: Coordenador Financeiro - FP&A
jobs.location: Av. Brigadeiro Faria Lima 3064, 9th Floor, Itaim Bibi
jobs.description: Introdução Bem-vindo à Gallagher – uma comunidade global de pessoas que trazem ideias ousadas, profunda expertise e um compromisso compartilhado com o que é certo. Ajudamos nossos clientes a enfrentar a complexidade com confiança, capacitando empresas, comunidades e indivíduos a prosperar. Na Gallagher, você encontrará mais do que um emprego; encontrará uma cultura construída sobre a confiança, impulsionada pela colaboração e sustentada pela crença de que somos melhores juntos. Seja atuando diretamente com clientes ou como parte da nossa equipe corporativa – na divisão de corretagem, na divisão de benefícios e consultoria de RH ou em nosso time interno – você terá a oportunidade de desenvolver sua carreira, causar impacto e fazer parte de algo maior. Vivencie um ambiente de trabalho onde você é incentivado a ser você mesmo, apoiado para alcançar o sucesso e inspirado a continuar aprendendo. Isso é viver o Jeito Gallagher. Visão gera Na Gallagher Brasil, FP&A tem um papel estratégico. A área apoia decisões importantes com planejamento financeiro, análises de desempenho e insights claros para o negócio. Nesta posição, você ajudará a fortalecer uma área em evolução. Você vai atuar perto da liderança e das áreas parceiras. Vai combinar visão estratégica com atuação prática no dia a dia. É uma oportunidade para quem gosta de organizar, analisar, influenciar e transformar dados em ações que geram valor. Como você causará um impacto Apoiar a liderança de FP&A na gestão do time, das prioridades e das entregas. Contribuir para um processo de planejamento mais forte, claro e confiável. Traduzir resultados financeiros e operacionais em recomendações objetivas para o negócio. Apoiar áreas comerciais, operacionais e corporativas com análises que ajudem na tomada de decisão. Identificar riscos, oportunidades e caminhos de melhoria com base em dados. Liderar ou apoiar ciclos de budget, forecast e planejamento de longo prazo. Acompanhar indicadores como receita, custos, despesas, rentabilidade, produtividade e headcount. Construir análises que ajudem a entender variações entre o planejado e o realizado. Garantir consistência e confiabilidade das informações vindas de diferentes fontes. Contribuir para dashboards, relatórios e materiais executivos mais claros e úteis. Apoiar iniciativas estratégicas, como novos projetos, expansão de filiais, integração de aquisições e melhoria de processos. Ajudar a tornar a área mais ágil, automatizada e orientada por dados. Atuar de forma hands-on sempre que necessário, sem perder a visão do todo. Sobre você Buscamos alguém com experiência sólida em FP&A e interesse real em apoiar pessoas, processos e decisões de negócio. Você pode ser uma ótima pessoa para esta vaga se: Tem ensino superior completo em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Economia, Engenharia ou área relacionada. Tem pelo menos cinco anos de experiência em FP&A. Já atuou no setor de seguros, em corretora ou seguradora. Tem experiência com liderança, coordenação ou organização de atividades de equipe. Já trabalhou como parceiro ou parceira de negócio, apoiando áreas internas na análise de resultados. Entende bem demonstrações financeiras e indicadores operacionais. Tem domínio avançado de Excel, incluindo Power Query, fórmulas avançadas e modelagem financeira. Sabe consolidar, tratar e validar dados de diferentes fontes. Consegue criar relatórios e apresentações executivas com clareza. Tem inglês avançado para reuniões e materiais com públicos internacionais. Gosta de atuar de forma prática quando necessário. Se comunica bem, organiza prioridades com facilidade e trabalha de forma colaborativa. Diferenciais desejáveis: Espanhol avançado. Experiência com Power BI ou outras ferramentas de visualização de dados. Conhecimento em automação e análise de dados com VBA, Python ou ferramentas semelhantes. Vivência com integração de aquisições, avaliação de projetos ou transformação financeira. A Gallagher valoriza diferentes trajetórias, experiências e perspectivas. Se você se identifica com esta oportunidade, queremos conhecer você. Pessoas de todas as origens são bem-vindas para se candidatar. Candidate-se e compartilhe esta vaga com sua rede.

Overview You’ll help keep revenue updates on track by coordinating forecast submissions, reconciling data from broker and operational systems, and supporting the monthly and ongoing forecasting cycle. You’ll also review variances, investigate forecast issues, and prepare commentary that helps leaders understand performance and next steps. Alongside forecasting, you’ll support SOX controls, exception monitoring, and audit evidence collection. You’ll also help maintain revenue details for shadow reporting across MGA, Programs, GP&P, and G-21 business lines, along with revenue share calculations and ad hoc analytics that support the wider finance team. How you'll make an impact Coordinate revenue updates, reconciling projections and validating data from operational and broker systems. Prepare forecasts and maintain uploads in OneStream and Excel. Monitor revenue performance, review variances, and recommend corrective actions. Prepare variance analysis and commentary for leadership. Support SOX controls, exception monitoring, and audit evidence collection. Maintain revenue information for internal reports and ad hoc analysis. Support the calculation and proper allocation of revenue share across different business lines. About you You have a bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, or a related field. Advanced English is required. You have 2 to 5 years of experience in financial services or insurance operations. Your background includes revenue management, accounting operations, budgeting, forecasting, or financial analysis. You can work with OneStream, Excel forecasts, and revenue reporting tools. jobs.title: Specialist-Project/Program Management
jobs.description: Introduction Welcome to Gallagher in India — where expertise, technology, and purpose come together. Since 2006, Gallagher in India has supported global teams by delivering quality, service, and speed through deep expertise, smart technology, and specialized knowledge services. More than just an operations center, it’s a place where careers grow through collaboration, continuous learning, and purposeful work. We drive efficiency, compliance, and innovation so our teams can focus on serving clients. If you enjoy solving problems and working with purpose, Gallagher is the place where you can grow and feel a sense of belonging. Overview We are looking to recruit a Specialist - Project/Programme to join the Gallagher Retail Change Operation Team. The Specialist will play a key role in supporting demand management, portfolio governance, and change delivery activities across the Retail business. The role is responsible for managing the intake, triage, prioritisation, and tracking of change requests, ensuring work is aligned with business priorities, available capacity, and divisional objectives. The successful candidate will support governance processes by coordinating the Retail Change Forum, preparing governance documentation and management reporting, maintaining visibility of change demand, and providing stakeholders with accurate insights on progress, risks, issues, dependencies, and outcomes. Working closely with Divisional Business Leaders, the Head of Change, Project Managers, and functional stakeholders across the division, the role will provide governance, oversight, and coordination across operational teams, business functions, and change initiatives. The position will support a broad range of business and operational activities, including system implementations, business change, integrations, and continuous improvement initiatives. The role reports to the Head of Change and Portfolio Manager and works collaboratively with project teams and stakeholders across multiple locations. The successful candidate will be comfortable working independently, managing competing priorities, coordinating governance activities, escalating risks and issues where appropriate, and supporting informed decision-making through timely and accurate reporting. A keen eye for detail, strong organisational skills, and the ability to maintain accurate documentation and reporting are essential. The role requires experience or knowledge of project, programme, change, demand, risk, business analysis, or portfolio management, together with proficiency in Microsoft Office applications. Strong PowerPoint skills are particularly important for developing presentations, dashboards, and management reports. Knowledge of Power BI, MS Visio, and project management tools would be advantageous. This position offers an excellent opportunity for professional growth and development within portfolio governance, demand management, project management, business analysis, and business change while working with a diverse range of stakeholders across the organisation. How you'll make an impact Responsibilities: Primary Responsibilities of the Project/Program Management Specialist: Understand the objectives, scope, priorities, and dependencies across portfolios, programmes, projects, and change initiatives. Receive, review, and triage new business requests by assessing business impact, complexity, risks, dependencies, and resource requirements. Classify requests as projects, small changes, business-as-usual (BAU) activities, or operational work. Coordinate triage discussions and governance forums, ensuring decisions, actions, and outcomes are documented and communicated to stakeholders. Maintain and manage the change demand pipeline, providing visibility of requests, priorities, resource capacity, and progress. Support demand management processes to improve governance, prioritisation, and decision-making across the portfolio. Support project and programme governance activities, including project setup, status tracking, data maintenance, and adherence to governance standards. Track and monitor key milestones, deliverables, dependencies, risks, issues, and actions, providing regular progress updates and ensuring timely closure. Maintain RAID logs and report on risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies, business impacts, and outstanding actions. Prepare and maintain portfolio, programme, project, and change governance reports for stakeholders. Support programme and portfolio-level budget monitoring, cost tracking, and reporting activities. Assist Programme Managers with resource planning, milestone tracking, risk management, and delivery reporting. Capture meeting minutes, key decisions, action items, and owners, and follow up on outstanding actions and deliverables. Create, update, and maintain programme documentation, plans, timelines, governance records, and expenditure tracking. Maintain the lessons learned repository and support post-implementation reviews to identify improvements and best practices. Develop, review, and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for project, programme, and business processes. Business Analysis Activities Understand business requirements within the Insurance domain and document project requirements. Perform business analysis and impact analysis activities for projects and change initiatives. Create, update, and maintain business and project documentation. Work with business stakeholders and project teams to elicit, analyse, validate, prioritise, and categorise requirements using a variety of techniques and methodologies. Facilitate stakeholder workshops and requirement-gathering sessions to achieve alignment and consensus on business needs. Analyse and document As-Is and To-Be processes, data flows, business rules, and system interactions to support change initiatives. Collaborate with development, testing, and project teams to ensure requirements are translated into effective solutions and support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) activities. Assess the impact of business, process, system, and regulatory changes, identifying associated risks, dependencies, and opportunities. Management Reporting Prepare executive-level project status reports and presentations to inform stakeholders of project progress and key updates. Create and maintain executive reporting packs, dashboards, and governance materials. Maintain the Consolidated Change Request Tracker, ensuring requests, priorities, statuses, dependencies, decisions, and outcomes are accurately recorded and kept up to date. Review project status, progress, milestones, risks, issues, and dependencies with Project Managers and project teams. Gather, analyse, and interpret project and portfolio data to identify trends, risks, issues, and opportunities for improvement. Compliance: Carry out duties following internal policies and procedures in accordance with applicable laws, rules, regulations, good governance, and Gallagher’s shared values, in particular, putting clients at the heart of our business. Comply with the AJG Professional Standards Manual in accordance with statutory requirements for role with specific attention, but not limited to Managing Client information, Whistle Blowing, Treating Customers Fairly. Leading Self Leading Self - Focuses on how we lead ourselves and react to situations. Integrity and Trust - Focuses on doing the right thing and taking personal responsibility. Leading Others and Relationships Builds Relationships and Networks - Focuses on building diverse networks and accepting difference. Collaborates - Focuses on sharing, supporting and being inclusive to achieve mutually beneficial outcomes. Communicates and Influences - Focuses on clear communication, influencing and negotiating. Leading Results Client Excellence - Focuses on understanding and meeting the needs of internal and external clients for now and the future of a long-term relationship. Analysis - Focuses on conducting analysis in order to provide requirements and solutions to meet business needs. Drive for Results - Focuses on performance and removing obstacles to achieve results. Skills and Competencies Knowledge of process and program management: Understanding of program management methodologies and processes to effectively support program activities. Strong Written and Verbal Communication: Ability to clearly convey information and ideas to team members, stakeholders, and clients. Presentation Skills: Proficiency in creating and delivering presentations to communicate program status and updates. Analytical / Business and Process Analysis: Capability to analyse business processes and data to support decision-making and program planning. Problem Solving: Strong ability to identify issues and develop effective solutions to overcome challenges. Adaptable and Flexible: Willingness to adjust to changing requirements and environments. Attention to Detail: Meticulous approach to managing documentation and tasks to ensure accuracy and completeness. Organizational and Time Management: Skills in prioritizing tasks and managing time effectively to meet deadlines. Interpersonal Skills: Ability to work collaboratively with diverse teams and build strong relationships with stakeholders. Technical Proficiency: Familiarity with project management software and tools (e.g., Microsoft Project, PlanView, or Smartsheet). About you Qualifications: Any Graduate or Postgraduate Licenses/Certificates Any Project Management Certification such as, Prince 2 Practioner, APM, PMP and Agile Certifications Technical Knowledge: Knowledge of financial services industry useful Desire to learn and understand tools and applications Competent with Power BI advantageous Essential: 6-8 years work experience in Project/Programme Management Good organisational and planning skills Strong attention to detail Ability to work in a complex environment and adapt to shifting priorities Adept at setting own work schedule and monitoring and reporting progress against goals Should have execellent communication in spoken and written English Good presentation skills Competent in Microsoft Tools Office Suite – Advanced Word, Excel & PowerPoint skills. Desirable: Project Management Tools such as, Microsoft Project, PlanView, or Smartsheet Additional Information At Gallagher, we believe supporting our colleagues goes far beyond the role itself. For more information, visit our Benefits page. Competitive compensation Comprehensive benefits programs designed to support your well-being Career development opportunities and ongoing learning A collaborative, people-first culture with accessible leadership The opportunity to do meaningful work with global reach and local impact At Gallagher, we are dedicated to building an inclusive and authentic workplace. If your past experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to join our Talent Community to stay connected to additional career opportunities.
